outputs.summary_en: The image shows a crowd of people, with a woman in the foreground appearing to shout or cheer, covering her mouth with her hand. The BBC News logo is visible in the bottom left corner. The accompanying news article reports on India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landing near the Moon's south pole, making India the first country to do so, and joining an elite club of nations to achieve a soft lunar landing.

outputs.visual_description_en: A medium shot shows a crowd of people, predominantly South Asian, reacting to an event. In the foreground, a woman with dark hair, wearing a yellow garment and gold earrings, has her mouth open as if shouting or cheering, with her right hand covering part of her mouth. She has a red bindi on her forehead and a ring on her finger. To her left, a man with glasses and a beard is partially visible. In the background, other people are seen with their arms raised. The bottom left corner of the image features the white 'BBC NEWS' logo on a black background.
